title: The influence of the substituent type and position on the topology of 2-D heterometallic sodium–palladium(II) coordination networks with substituted nicotinate ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9520-9529
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08782A, Paper
Open Access

Ivan Kodrin, Maricel Gabriela Rodríguez, Nives Politeo, Željka Soldin, Igor Kerš, Tomislav Rončević, Vedrana Čikeš Čulić, Vesna Sokol, Fabio Doctorovich, Boris-Marko Kukovec
Two 2-D heterometallic sodium–palladium(II) coordination networks with 2-methylnicotinate and 6-fluoronicotinate ligands were prepared, showing that the substituent type and position control a linear or zigzag topology.
